Frequently Asked Technical Questions

How does this tool parse cURL arguments safely?+
Parsing runs entirely in client-side JavaScript by tokenizing shell argument quotes (-H, -d, -X, -u, -b). No code is sent to an external server or evaluated in a dangerous shell context.
Can this convert POST bodies with JSON?+
Yes. If the cURL command includes --data, --data-raw, or -d containing JSON, it automatically parses the body into native language objects or structs (like json.loads in Python or JSON.stringify in Fetch).
